description: Source code defining the CertPrincipal class for handling X.509 certificate principal information, including parsing distinguished names and retrieving display names.

classes.name: CertPrincipal
classes.description: Represents the principal (subject or issuer) in an X.509 certificate, with methods to parse distinguished names and retrieve display names.

methods.name: CertPrincipal(const std::string& name)
methods.description: Constructor initializing CertPrincipal with a common name.

methods.name: ParseDistinguishedName
methods.description: Parses a distinguished name from DER-encoded data and extracts various name attributes.

methods.name: GetDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a string suitable for display, prioritizing common name, organization, then organizational unit.
